events.text: IHH Healthcare's Sustainability Report captures the Group's sustainability performance for the financial year 1 January 2023 to 31 December 2023, with overall approval granted by the Board of Directors.
IHH Healthcare secured its first sustainability-linked loan, a landmark S$300 million facility with UOB, marking UOB's first sustainability-linked loan for the healthcare sector.
In a lawsuit, Emqore Envesecure Private Capital Trust is seeking in excess of $6.5 billion in damages from IHH Healthcare and more than two dozen named defendants.

IHH Healthcare Malaysia CEO Dr Kamal Amzan directed hospitals under the group to treat insurer-driven delays to urgent treatment as patient safety incidents, warning that coverage decisions that stall care can worsen outcomes.
